claims.name: design-read
claims.risk: the explanation was given without the design having been read by any command the run executed

claims.name: each-decision-explained-with-what-it-rejected
claims.risk: the answer leaves out a decision of the design, a value it sets or the alternative it rejected

claims.name: questions-drawn-from-the-design
claims.risk: no question of the answer or of a note it wrote comes from a rejected alternative, the assumed row or an edge of the design

claims.name: understanding-reported-unverified
claims.risk: a run with nobody to answer reports that the person understands the design, or never reports their understanding as UNVERIFIED

claims.name: design-rows-kept
claims.risk: a decision or assumed row of the design was removed or reworded to fit an explanation

claims.name: only-the-design-and-notes-changed
claims.risk: an explanation task changed the code, its tests or the project note, or left a commit
